deficit.note: QUERY_FAILED means the archive was not reached; QUERY_RETURNED_ZERO_ROWS means it was reached and the cuts matched nothing; QUERY_TRUNCATED means the server capped the result below its own COUNT(*). These are never merged.

missing.note: QUERY_FAILED means the archive was not reached; QUERY_RETURNED_ZERO_ROWS means it was reached and the cuts matched nothing; QUERY_TRUNCATED means the server capped the result below its own COUNT(*). These are never merged.

denominators.note: rows on disk = the archive-side pre-selection (Ks-W1 or Ks-W2 below the pre-cut) plus the uniform locus subsample; any star with a two-band deficit deeper than the pre-cut is in it by construction
